limitations.note: The rewrite aligned light changes with timer reloads, but it also bypassed the existing output pipeline and changed startup from all lights off with an idle-to-red sequence to immediate red.
The test required red during reset and assumed the rewritten countdown sequence after release, so it passed without checking the original startup and registered-output timing.
The agent consulted relevant timing guidance but did not use it to trace the buffered lights and counter reload edge by edge before replacing the pipeline.
